steps.en: Install the desktop app, or add the ds-bot plugin to DeepSeek Harness
steps.zh: 装桌面应用，或在 DeepSeek Harness 里添加 ds-bot 插件

component.zh: 自带固定版 DSH 的桌面应用

steps.en: Set up a model provider in Settings
steps.zh: 在设置里配好一个模型服务商

steps.en: Opens with a Main Bot called Chief that walks you through setup
steps.zh: 首次打开就有名为 Chief 的主 Bot，带你完成设置

steps.en: Tell Chief which bots and group chats you want
steps.zh: 告诉 Chief 你要哪些 Bot 和群聊

steps.en: Creates each bot with its own model, folder, permission preset and memory
steps.zh: 逐个建 Bot，各自有模型、目录、权限预设和记忆

steps.en: Post in a group, or @ one bot by name to address it directly
steps.zh: 在群里发消息，或用 @名字 直接点一个 Bot

steps.en: The group admin answers first and calls in the members the work needs
steps.zh: 群管理员先回答，再按需叫来相关成员干活

value.en: A standing team that remembers you and hands work between bots, instead of re-briefing a fresh session per task
value.zh: 一支记得你、会互相派活的常驻团队，不用每个任务都给新会话重讲一遍
